title: Cortex: Measurement-Gated Evolution and Pruning of Coding-Agent Skills and Rules
abstract: arXiv:2610.14216v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents such as Claude Code also follow text files that developers write for them: a project file, skills the agent may choose to open, and rules that load automatically when the agent reads matching files. We call these files the agent's harness. Developers add to it whenever they correct the agent, but one success proves little: the same agent can pass a task once and fail it the next time.   We present Cortex, a tool that tests changes to the harness instead of trusting them. It saves fixes from the developer's sessions as replayable tasks, finds the corrections that recur, writes one skill or rule at a time, and keeps it only if repeated runs with and without it show a net gain and no task made noticeably worse. Existing text is tested the same way before it is deleted, and Cortex neither adds nor deletes text the agent never used.   We tested Cortex with Claude Haiku 4.5 on a repository built for the purpose, with convention

translated_title: Cortex：基于度量门控的编码智能体技能与规则的演化与剪枝
translated_abstract: 诸如 Claude Code 这样的编码智能体还会遵循开发者为它们编写的文本文件：一个项目文件、智能体可以选择打开的技能，以及当智能体读取匹配文件时自动加载的规则。我们将这些文件称为智能体的“套件”。每当开发者纠正智能体时，就会向其中添加内容，但一次成功并不能说明什么：同一个智能体可能这次通过了某个任务，下次却失败了。我们提出了 Cortex，一个对套件更改进行测试而非盲目信任的工具。它将开发者会话中的修复保存为可重放的任务，找出反复出现的纠正，每次只编写一个技能或规则，并且只有在带与不带该更改的重复运行显示出净收益、且没有任何任务明显变差时才保留它。现有文本在删除前也会以同样的方式进行测试，并且 Cortex 既不会添加也不会删除智能体从未使用过的文本。我们在一个为此目的构建的仓库上使用 Claude Haiku 4.5 对 Cortex 进行了测试……
tldr: Cortex 通过将开发者的修复保存为可重放任务，并以带与不带更改的重复运行的实测净收益作为门控条件，来验证、演化与剪枝编码智能体的技能与规则文件，从而避免仅凭单次成功就盲目信任对智能体套件的修改。
en_tdlr: Cortex validates, evolves, and prunes coding-agent skills and rules (the "harness") by saving developer fixes as replayable tasks and gating every addition or deletion on measured net gains from repeated runs with and without the change, rather than trusting one-off successes.
